_meta.description: AI-DLC pipeline framework config. Defines all valid states, allowed transitions, and the skills relevant at each stage. Loaded by state-loader before any skill runs.
_meta.entry_point: aidlc-init is the orchestrator entry point. It bootstraps state.json (not-started) and chains aidlc-epic-scaffold (context) -> aidlc-vision-doc (vision) -> aidlc-adr (ADR) -> generate-system-prompts (adr_decisions.xml) -> aidlc-design-driven-dev (HLD -> LLD -> EARS). It is resumable via state-loader. After design-completed, aidlc-jira-story-breakdown (prioritization), aidlc-tdd (implementation), and aidlc-gacr (PR review at review-in-progress) are separate governed skills, not chained by aidlc-init.
_meta.source_of_truth: The epic's state.json is the single source of truth for its current status. Do not re-derive status by scanning disk artifacts; trust state.json.
_meta.state_writer: state-loader is READ-ONLY. status is written by: (1) aidlc-init at bootstrap (not-started) and on the design-in-progress/design-completed hops; (2) aidlc-epic-scaffold on the context-ready hop; (3) aidlc-vision-doc on the inception-completed hop; (4) aidlc-adr (+ generate-system-prompts ADR mode) on the adr-completed hop; (5) aidlc-jira-story-breakdown on the prioritization-completed hop AND the stories map (ears_ref, lld_ref, blockedBy); (6) aidlc-tdd on the implementation-in-progress hop (first story claim) and per-story status; (7) aidlc-gacr on the implementation-completed → review-in-progress hop (when a PR exists) and audit.md review rows via aidlc-approve — GACR does not write shipped. A status change is valid only when the transition trigger is met, and MUST be accompanied by a new row in the epic's audit.md.

not-started.label: Not Started
not-started.description: Bootstrap state written by aidlc-init before inception runs: state.json exists with status not-started, but no system prompts or vision yet. state-loader also infers this state if the file is absent (an epic dir created by hand).

context-ready.label: Context Ready
context-ready.description: Context summary approved and system-prompts/context.xml written. Ready for vision document generation.

inception-completed.label: Inception Completed
inception-completed.description: system-prompts/context.xml and vision.md have been created and approved. Ready for ADR authoring.

adr-completed.label: ADR Completed
adr-completed.description: ADR Gate 2 passed; adr.md and system-prompts/adr_decisions.xml written. Ready to enter design phase.

design-in-progress.label: Design In Progress
design-in-progress.description: HLD/LLD/EARS work has started but at least one design artifact is still pending approval.

design-completed.label: Design Completed
design-completed.description: HLD, all LLDs, and all EARS files are approved and coherent. Ready for RPT prioritization (aidlc-jira-story-breakdown) to populate the stories map.

prioritization-completed.label: Prioritization Completed
prioritization-completed.description: Approved vertical slices written to the state.json stories map (each with ears_ref, lld_ref, blockedBy). Ready for aidlc-tdd to claim the frontier.

implementation-in-progress.label: Implementation In Progress
implementation-in-progress.description: One or more implementation stories are actively being developed.

implementation-completed.label: Implementation Completed
implementation-completed.description: All planned stories are implemented. Ready for PR review.

review-in-progress.label: Review In Progress
review-in-progress.description: Pull request(s) are open. Default gate is aidlc-gacr: adversarial review against the team's collective-feedback guidelines.

shipped.label: Shipped
shipped.description: All PRs merged and the feature is live.

not-started.trigger: Context summary approved; context.xml written to system-prompts/

context-ready.trigger: vision.md Gate 2 approved and written to EPIC_DIR

inception-completed.trigger: ADR Gate 2 approved; adr.md written; adr_decisions.xml written

adr-completed.trigger: HLD draft created and presented for review

design-in-progress.trigger: HLD + all planned LLDs + all EARS files explicitly approved and audit.md updated.

design-completed.trigger: Approved breakdown written into state.json stories; each entry has title, status, ears_ref, lld_ref, and blockedBy.

prioritization-completed.trigger: First implementation story claimed by aidlc-tdd.

implementation-in-progress.trigger: All stories in the stories map reach status=done, and aidlc-tdd Step 5.5 has mapped vision.md Success Criteria to concrete metrics/tests in audit.md.

not-started.note: Prefer aidlc-init: it orchestrates inception + ADR + design end-to-end and is resumable. aidlc-epic-scaffold can be run directly for context gathering only.

context-ready.note: Generate and approve vision.md before ADR authoring.

inception-completed.note: ADR is required before design. Run aidlc-adr to lock architecture decisions, then refresh system-prompts with adr_decisions.xml.

adr-completed.note: Start design phase. aidlc-design-driven-dev will guide HLD → LLD → EARS. aidlc-adr is available for ADR revisions only.

design-in-progress.note: Continue design phase. Do not write implementation code yet.

design-completed.note: Design is locked. Run aidlc-jira-story-breakdown to prioritize vertical slices into the stories map. aidlc-design-driven-dev is available for design revisions only.

prioritization-completed.note: Stories map is populated. Run aidlc-tdd to claim a frontier story (blockedBy all done). Re-run aidlc-jira-story-breakdown only to revise the map.

implementation-in-progress.note: Actively building stories via aidlc-tdd. Update state.json stories map as each story progresses.

implementation-completed.note: All stories done and vision Success Criteria mapped to metrics/tests in audit.md (aidlc-tdd Step 5.5). Open PR, then advance to review-in-progress and run aidlc-gacr.

review-in-progress.note: Default PR gate is aidlc-gacr against collective-feedback-guidelines.md. Align on the existing guidelines; do not start a second review loop. After user-approved GACR, merge the PR to reach shipped.

shipped.note: Epic is complete. No further skill execution needed.

governance.epic_dir_note: Canonical directory is aidlc-docs/<epic-name>_<epic-id>. Create and resolve only this form. One epic = one directory.
rules: state.json is the authoritative status; audit.md is the append-only human-readable ledger.
A status change is valid only if the target state appears in transitions[current].next (or transitions[current].rollback).
Whenever status changes, append one row to audit.md with the UTC timestamp, phase, skill, action, and approver.
Migration: if status is inception-completed but adr.md or system-prompts/adr_decisions.xml is missing, route to aidlc-adr — do not start aidlc-design-driven-dev.
Stories map is empty until aidlc-jira-story-breakdown writes it at the design-completed → prioritization-completed hop. Do not start aidlc-tdd tracked work before that hop.

state_json_schema.epic-id: string — short identifier or Jira key (e.g. IAM-123 or rate-limiting-user-userid)
state_json_schema.status: string — must be one of the keys in states above
state_json_schema.stories: object — keyed by story-id; each value is { title: string, status: one of story_statuses, ears_ref: string, lld_ref: string (empty string allowed on Lightweight / EARS-only epics), blockedBy: array of story-ids }
